summary: Iteration 32 · Targeted retest of BUG-5 (Venue filter in Tournament Create modal) after the two-part fix (backend venues_grounds.py:87-88 auto-include of MPCA-owned venues for sub-body personas + frontend TournamentCreateModal.jsx:117-134 rewrite to filter by hostBody.seat city). Both fixes VERIFIED END-TO-END. Backend curl: GET /api/venues returns 320 for X-Body-Code MPCA, DIV-IND, and DIV-BPL alike (320 in each; distribution: Indore=128, Bhopal=64, Gwalior=64, Jabalpur=64). UI (Division Secretary persona-chip-division-secretary): opened trn-create modal → default Host=MPCA shows 320 venue options, NO helper text; changing Host to DIV-IND shrinks to 128 options and helper text renders exactly 'Showing 128 of 320 venues — filtered to your host body.'; changing to DIV-BPL (Bhopal Division — note actual body code is DIV-BPL, not DIV-BHOP as review-request mentioned) shrinks to 64 with same helper 'Showing 64 of 320 venues — filtered to your host body.'; switching back to MPCA restores 320 and helper vanishes. Same behaviour confirmed for the MPCA persona (persona-chip-secretary). Regression sanity-checked: BUG-3 all 5 persona chip names on /login correct (MS Mahanaryaman Scindia · PRESIDENT, SD Sanjeev Dua · HON. SECRETARY, DN Devashish Nilosey · DIVISION SECRETARY, RK Rajesh Kulkarni · DISTRICT SECRETARY, CP Chandrakant Pandit · MATCH OFFICIAL); BUG-1 Grant Claim chips render on all 13 non-tournament schemes and absent on the 8 tournament ones; BUG-4 scheme dropdown lists exactly the 10 reimbursement/tournament schemes (2-A..2-E, 3-A..3-D, 9-BCCI); BUG-6 Submit Budget flow — TRN-2025-26-037 from iter31 is now in Submitted state (submit-budget-btn correctly hidden, budget-submitted-badge = 'AWAITING MPCA APPROVAL', budget-total = ₹2,89,340). All 6 BUGs now PASS.

issues: Pre-existing hydration console warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' still emitted for every dynamic <option>. Root cause is Emergent's automated data-ve-dynamic tracking wrappers, not the app code. Cosmetic only, has been present since iter30. No app-side action required.

critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/components/TournamentCreateModal.jsx:120-134 — filteredVenues now correctly uses hostBody.seat (city) as the primary filter with owner/managed_by/body_id override fallbacks. Recommended cosmetic tweak: hostBody.seat is always populated in the seed data, so the '.replace(/\s+(Division|District)$/i, "")' fallback on name is defensive-only. Consider adding a unit test that pins the filter contract (DIV-IND → filter by 'Indore', DIV-BPL → 'Bhopal') so future body-code renames don't silently break the filter.

backend/routes/venues_grounds.py:87-88 — the sub-body auto-inclusion of {owner_body_id:'MPCA'} is correct for the tournament-hosting use case but broadens the read scope for ALL /api/venues calls made by Division/District personas. If later modules rely on strict body-owned lists (e.g. Ground Expenses dashboards), they will now leak MPCA-owned venues. Consider gating this branch behind an explicit query flag (e.g. include_shared_pool=true) rather than making it the default.

frontend/src/components/TournamentCreateModal.jsx:126 — hostBody.seat / hostBody.name matching uses .toLowerCase().includes(seat). If a body seat contains an ambiguous substring (e.g. seat 'Ind' matching 'Indore', 'Indergarh') collisions could occur. Current seed is safe, but consider exact city match (===) with a small city-alias map for edge cases.

rca of the issue: BUG-5 root cause (from iter31) was a two-layer scoping mismatch: (a) backend /api/venues auto-scope excluded MPCA-owned venues for Division/District personas → Division Secretary saw 0 venues; (b) frontend filteredVenues had a permissive fallback v.owner_body_id==='MPCA' that matched every seeded venue → MPCA persona never saw the list shrink. Fix applied in iter32: (1) backend venues_grounds.py:87-88 appends {owner_body_id:'MPCA'} to the OR-scope when the persona body_code is not 'MPCA', so sub-body personas now see the state-owned shared pool. (2) frontend TournamentCreateModal.jsx:117-134 replaced the MPCA-fallback with a hostBody.seat city filter, so switching Host = DIV-IND filters to venues where city matches 'Indore', etc. Verified: DIV-IND → 128 Indore venues, DIV-BPL → 64 Bhopal venues, MPCA → all 320 (no helper); helper text 'Showing X of Y venues — filtered to your host body.' renders exactly per spec.
